# Forge corresponding source

GNU GPL v3 applies here. This directory preserves the current patched native Java source and source identities. MTGB changes are described by Tools/ForgeBridge/NativePatches.json.

The local 2.0.16 build includes its upstream archive in ForgeRuntime/source. The corresponding MTGB overlay is assembled by Tools/ForgeBridge/Export-CorrespondingSource.py. The [previously published source](https://github.com/plmoknzxc/MTGB/releases/tag/forge-source-20261016) corresponds to the older build.

The source manifest identifies exact archives and SHA256 values. The original Forge copyright notices remain in every source file. The root project MIT license does not relicense Forge.
